observations: The page number «( 17 )» stands at the head of the page, centred, and the signature «2» of the printed sheet at the foot, centred. The page has no footnotes.

L01-L18: the division of 1800 by 9 (p. 16, frame 022, L16-L33) concluded: the quotient «ducenti», 200, and nothing remains. L02-L08: a shortening, «quedam abreuiacio propinqua»: when the number divided is left with circles before which there is no figure, those circles, from the beginning of its places towards the right, are added to what the division gives. L08-L18: «Ordo autem primus est ordo operis»: 1800 by 9 worked with the shortening: two circles, eight in the third place and one in the fourth; nine set under eight, being more than the one in the last place; two written above, two by nine, eighteen, taken from eighteen, leaves two circles with no figure before them; the two circles written after the two give «.cc.», 200. L18 «quorum hec est figura.»: the figure is not printed.

L19-L22: the end of multiplication and division of whole numbers, «in eo numero qui fuerit integer»; the multiplication and division of fractions and the extraction of roots are announced. L23-L33: fractions, «fraciones»: their many names, half, third, quarter, ninth, tenth, a part of thirteen, a part of eighteen; the sexagesimal parts of the Indians: one divided into sixty minutes, a minute into sixty seconds, one second being one part of 3600, a second into sixty thirds, one third being one part of 216000 («ducentis milibus et xvi. milibus»), a third into sixty fourths, and so on without end. The page ends in the course of the sentence.

L24: the vertical bar between «merabilibus» and «atque», with a word space on each side, marks the beginning of fol. 108 recto of the manuscript, which the note in the right margin, «car. 108 recto.», names; transcribed as a margin note.

Numerals: L10 «.dccc,» and L11 «.viii,» without the closing point; L10 «viii.,», L25 «xiii.,», L29 «lx.», L32 «xvi.» and L33 «lx.» without the opening point; L25 «.x.viii.,», eighteen, with a point between «x» and «viii».

L23-L24: «in nu-|merabilibus», innumerabilibus, is printed as two words, 25 px apart; transcribed as printed. L23 «fraciones», with c for ct, and L26 «Set indi» are transcribed as printed. L05: «differentiarum diuisi», the two words 8 px apart, where the other word spaces of the line are 13 to 18 px; transcribed with a space.

Spaces at punctuation (rule of tools/punct.py: after a mark, a space where the gap is at least 12 px or two thirds of the median word space of the line; before a mark, where it is at least 10 px): with a space before the mark, L04 «numerus ,» (16 px), L06 «dexteram ,» (12 px), L10 «differentia ,» (20 px) and L17 «duorum ,» (20 px); without a space before the mark, L15 «.ix.,» (9 px, where the comma of L14 «.ix.,» stands 5 px from the point). With a space after the mark, L03 «aliquem, et» (11 px, the median word space of the line 16 px), L25 «xiii., et» (12 px) and L28 «.lx. partes» (13 px). A speck below the comma of L12 «illo,», the pencil slash after the comma of L15 «.ix.,» and the stroke after the colon of L26 «sexaginta:» shorten the measured gaps; the spaces there are read on the scan. The semicolons of L01, L07, L12, L29, L30 and L32 have printed tails (darkest pixel 29 to 76); the colons of L02, L09, L11 and L26 have none.

Marks not transcribed: L12, a dark speck, 9 by 8 px, 4 px below the comma of «illo,», not joined to it; L26, a short oblique stroke, 6 by 9 px, above and to the right of the colon of «sexaginta:», lighter than the print (darkest pixel 77, mean 128), and a light speck at mid-height after «suarum». Below L33 the text of p. 18 shows through the leaf, mirrored.
copy_matter: A reader's notes in pencil: faint, apparently erased writing in the right margin beside L08, not read; L10, a stroke above «circuli»; L13, a slash through the comma after «duo», and «/ hier ist Platz freigelassen» (German, here a space has been left free) in the right margin beside L13-L14; L15, «et» marked for deletion between two slashes, with the two strokes joined and the deletion sign (deleatur) in the right margin; L23, arcs above and below joining «in» and «nu-»; L25, «viii» of «.x.viii.» underlined, and «ta» and «VIII» below the printed folio note. Not part of the edition.
